description: This file defines the 'HomeScreen' component for a React Native application, which displays categories, lists videos, handles loading/error/empty states, and navigates to detail screens.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Main functional component displaying categories and videos; manages UI states, handles refresh and navigation.

methods.description: Component rendering UI when there's an error loading video data.
